ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 90% of the visible fluke surface area; low-intensity black pixels occupy approximately 10% concentrated at the terminal boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Macro-scale contiguous white field across the interior fluke surface; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a narrow band (5-15 pixel width) along the trailing edge and lobe tips; localized grey/tan mottling clusters are visible on the medial right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 74 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged serrations across the entire trailing edge; average peak amplitude of 8-12 pixels; serration density is highest on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges; the trailing edge maintains a wide-angle concave arc from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent circular clusters (high-contrast yellowish centers with dark perimeters) located at the distal tips of both lobes; several faint circular depressions visible across the white medial surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected in the mid-left and lower-central fluke regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single, well-defined circular perforation (tissue void/hole) through the right lobe, approximately 120 pixels to the right of the median notch apex.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of a through-and-through circular hole in the right lobe is the primary distinctive structural marker.
